note: Maps each torch module/op to the tt_symbiote TTNN class. status: GREEN (real PCC on P150), IMPLEMENTED (forward written, validated), SCAFFOLD (forward NotImplementedError), BLOCKED (attempted, blocker recorded), CUSTOM-NEEDED (no reusable class), INLINE (ttnn op inside a composite forward).

DeepseekV2RMSNorm.notes: reused; @run_on_devices(T3K) - test re-decorates forward to widen to P150 (hardware retarget shim)

nn.Embedding.notes: reused; indices MUST be ttnn.uint32 (auto-convert of int64 via __call__ yields wrong dtype -> feed uint32 directly). arch widened in test

nn.GELU.notes: reused; arch widened in test. SAM MLPBlock uses GELU

quick_gelu (x*sigmoid(1.702x)).notes: CLIP FFN; not nn.GELU. inline ttnn.multiply(x, ttnn.sigmoid(ttnn.multiply(x,1.702)))

LayerNorm2d (channel-first).notes: SAM neck; manual mean/var over dim=1

nn.LayerNorm.notes: reused; CLIP/SAM standard LN. arch widened in test

nn.Conv2d (NHWC).notes: reused; SAM patch_embed/neck/net convs. Tier1 test covers all 5 configs (k16s16, k1, k3p1, k3s2p1 x2); NHWC in/out; k3 convs need device l1_small_size=32768; conv2d runs on device (only the trivial output TTNNReshape is a known shared T3K-guard fallback)

scaled_dot_product_attention (ttnn.trans.notes: bf16 flash-SDPA; backs LlamaMHA + CLIP attn + SAM global-layer attn. Tier1 standalone test (non-causal) vs torch SDPA

softmax (ttnn.softmax).notes: backs MoE fp32 router scoring + SAM window fp32 attn. Tier1 standalone test vs torch.softmax

RoPE / rotate_half (HF-Llama).notes: exact ttnn ops from TTNNUnlimitedOcrLlamaMHA._rope; Tier1 standalone test vs torch apply_rotary_pos_emb (q*cos + rotate_half(q)*sin)

DeepseekV2MLP (dense SwiGLU).notes: IMPLEMENTED: down(silu(gate(x))*up(x)) via child TTNNLinear.forward + inline ttnn.silu/multiply

DeepseekV2MoE.notes: single-device softmax-scoring greedy top-6 routing (adapted from modules/ttnn_moe.py); dense expert compute + threshold gate matrix; 64 routed + 2 shared experts

SlidingWindowLlamaAttention.notes: prefill path: q/k/v proj -> HF-Llama RoPE (rotate_half) -> causal bf16 SDPA -> o_proj. cos/sin threaded via position_embeddings

SAM attention (rel-pos, windowed).notes: windowed layers run fp32 manual attn (QK^T + rel_pos_bias -> softmax -> AV); global layers keep bf16 flash-SDPA

DeepseekV2DecoderLayer (dense L0).notes: RMSNorm + LlamaMHA + dense SwiGLU MLP (layer 0); RMSNorm + LlamaMHA + MoE (layers 1..11), all green

SAM Block.notes: LN + windowed/global SAM attn + MLP(GELU); part of the green SAM encoder tower

CLIP Block.notes: LN + bf16 SDPA attn + quick_gelu FFN; part of the green CLIP encoder tower

UnlimitedOCRForCausalLM.notes: full e2e: text-only path GREEN 0.99768; VLM (image+text) path GREEN 0.99442

DeepEncoder.notes: functional at 0.984 (< 0.99 gate): SAM(0.9987) fed into bf16 CLIP tower amplifies residual bf16 SDPA error; CLIP fed the REAL SAM features greens at 0.997. Closing fully needs fp32 attention (OOM/perf cost)

SAM encoder.notes: patch_embed + pos_embed + 12 blocks + neck/net conv compressor; window layers fp32 attn to clear the 0.99 gate

CLIP encoder.notes: embeddings(cls+pos) + pre_layrnorm + 24 blocks; fed REAL SAM features

lm_head (nn.Linear 1280->129280).notes: same TTNNLinear op as tier1; wired into the green ForCausalLM e2e
